items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Whenever I hear things like decentralization, I think of people like Ronald Reagan.

ctx.x: I think any country. I went to Germany and the same thing was there. I'm thinking of how that can be thwarted. I think--supposing a strong person did exist who left to laisse faire devices, would accomplish what we just suggested could be accomplished and could be thwarted by the fact of centralized communications network. Maybe he centralizes the wrong thing, because there's been too much said recently about decentralization, so that I have come to suspect very much.

Whenever I hear things like decentralization, I think of people like Ronald Reagan. What alarms me is if you go back to that sort of thing, people seem to forget that we moved away from it just because--
Divide and conquer, among other things.
